As informed to you earlier vide our letter dated 02nd November, 2026, the 04th of 2026-27 meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company was held on Friday, the 13th day of November, 2026, commenced at 03:30 P.M. and concluded at 05:30 P.M. A copy of Statement of Un-Audited Financial Results along with Auditor's Limited Review Report thereon for the 02nd quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026, as required under Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, is enclosed herewith for your record and reference.
